notes.title: August Dev-Log
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]This month's development for Chaos Front continues to focus on producing art assets. Unit combat animations will remain my primary task for the next several months.[/p][p][/p][p]To break up the monotony of art production, I try to introduce a few new features each month. This month's addition is the ship renaming feature, which was suggested by several players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/d884b18895ec60c4ec4afcf05bccc6c161429aa4.png"][/img][/p][p]At the Shipyard, you can now rename your owned ships. Renaming costs 1,000 credits to cover maintenance fees for the Galactic Ship Information Network. The new names will be saved to your player save file, which may slightly increase your game save size.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for this dev-log. See you next month.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Han Zhiyu[/p]

notes.title: July Dev-Log
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]You may have already noticed that the game's release date now shows 2025 instead of a specific time. I need to explain the reasons behind this decision.[/p][p][/p][p]First, the art work has exceeded expectations, making it impossible for me to accurately estimate the completion time. Second, during the level creation process, I discovered that it would be very difficult to differentiate between the originally planned four selectable protagonists. Unlike grand strategy games as Chaos Galaxy that change with each playthrough, Chaos Front is a story-rich SRPG, if different protagonists experience mostly the same missions, the gameplay would become boring.[/p][p][/p][p]Therefore, I've reduced the number of available protagonists to two. Many other characters that were previously designed have been repurposed as enemy and ally characters that appear in the story. This way, each of the two protagonists will have sufficiently rich and distinct story experiences.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, my previous plan to start Early Access with partial protagonists and release the full version later also needs to change. Given the frequent content modifications currently happening, the more responsible way to provide everyone with a complete story and gaming experience would be to release the full version without EA. Therefore, Chaos Front will no longer begin Early Access in Q3 of this year, but will instead launch as a full version directly after all content is finished in a few more months.[/p][p][/p][p]I will inform everyone of the new release date once most of the work is completed. Until then, I apologize that I cannot provide a definitive date for now.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, this announcement's cover features a new Alien apostle image. Yes, an apostle will appear in Chaos Front. In Chaos Galaxy 2, we commanded massive fleets in galaxy-scale battles against the Black Dragon's alien host. Now, going back over a thousand years in time, we become a mercenary group with only a few ships, about to face this powerful cosmic monster and its alien army directly.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for this dev-log. See you next month.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Han Zhiyu[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: June dev-log
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]In the past month, I am still busy with the production of missions.[/p][p][/p][p]My current workflow is: Design about a dozen missions each time, complete the level design and dialogue text. Sort out the new characters and units that appear in this batch of missions. Draw the character portraits and unit combat animations. Put all the new art resources into the game and debug the levels.[/p][p][/p][p]This way of working allows me to focus on the shaping of certain series of stories and characters for a period of time, so that the missions can have story connections and similar design styles, but not become a emotionless assembly line production of hundreds of missions in batches. This boring but solid process needs to be repeated about four to five times before the mission content of Chaos Front can be concluded.[/p][p][/p][p]At the same time, I also made some improvements to the game when I had ideas. For example, now we can right-click the unit chess pieces on the battlefield to view their detailed data. The display of character stories and items has been added to the data interface. We can better understand the hundreds of characters that appear in the world of Chaos Front.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/d590fa7f62046a74406a5ed696287628717ef558.png"][/img][/p][p]That’s all for this dev-log. See you next month.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Han Zhiyu[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: May dev-log
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

While I am busy drawing, I find it‘s time to write a new dev-log.

In the two months since the Next Fest, I have completed about a dozen character portraits and a dozen unit designs and animations. The development progress is slower than I expected. But a lot of basic work has been completed, such as the animations of the beam field and the magnetic field, the logic and animation of the spacemine, etc. Of course, time was wasted in several failed attempts.

This time, let me introduce the spacemine in Chaos Front. In Chaos Galaxy 2, I actually tried to develop some mines, but found that this type of unit is very useless in a grand strategy game, so it was not implemented in CG2 in the end. But in the missions of Chaos Front, I found that mines are interesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/38041df30ad3244f5ab6f417bd92fe0b86c0b149.png[/img]

The enemy's mines will be laid in the battlemap in an invisible way. We can use our ship's Detect to find them. When our units move near the mines, they will also be found. However, if our units move through a mine tile, we will be ambushed, and will not only take explosion damage and fall into chaos for 1 turn, but also take debuffs such as burn, corrosion, and E-disrupt depending on the mine type. You can directly clear them by assaulting or bombarding.

In the game process, there will be some missions that require searching and clearing enemy minefields. Sometimes you can also use friendly mines to hinder the enemy. In addition, we can also try to push the enemy to minefields with rams...

It is Children's Day and Chinse Duanwu Festival, I wish you good health and happiness. Let's talk again next month.



Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Spanish-LATAM available! Request for testing and reports
notes.notes:
A new good news!

Two months ago, a friend contacted me and said he wanted to translate Chaos Front into Spanish-LATAM. He is Genow, and he used to work for the famous game Bug Fables.

After two months of hard work, he has completed the Spanish-LATAM version of Chaos Front DEMO!

However, since I don't know Spanish, and it is difficult for him to complete a comprehensive testing of the entire game alone. Therefore, we hope that Spanish speaking players of Chaos Front can help us test and improve the text. You can download the DEMO and choose the Español - Latinoamérica version. Look for the part that is showing incomplete or untranslated in it, take a screenshot and send it to us.

You can report it in this post on the Steam forum（https://steamcommunity.com/app/2770330/discussions/0/597400139015921458/） or in the text-edit channel of the discord of Chaos Front. 

Every report will make the Spanish text of Chaos Front more perfect! I hope you can contribute your valuable suggestions. Thank you!



Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Japanese retranslation and April dev-log
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

In the feedbacks of DEMO, many Japanese players mentioned the poor Japanese localization of Chaos Front. So I sent a request for help to Japanese players. We are lucky to get the help of Inaba (eps_r), who has made the Japanese translation mods of Warborn and Inertial Drift. After a month of hard work, he retranslated all the Japanese texts in Chaos Front DEMO, made a lot of changes from worldsetting names to option names, and rewrote the dialogue according to the character's personality. Let us thank him for his enthusiasm and dedication!

The development of the full version game has entered the arduous art mass production stage. According to my work this month, it takes an average of 1 day for each character portrait, and an average of 4 days for the battle animation, weapon effects, and chess pieces of each unit. And now there are still 80 characters and 60 units of art resources that have not been completed. A simple calculation shows that the remaining art work alone will take half a year. Therefore, I changed the release time displayed in the store to the third quarter 2025. In fact, I estimate that the EA of Chaos Front will not start until September or even October. I must apologize to you for the delay in the release time, but I believe that everyone would rather play a more complete game.

Among the new features added this month, it is worth mentioning that the battlefield terrain has become richer. Many players mentioned the lack of multiple terrains in the feedback of DEMO. In the past few weeks, I have added asteroid belts and 3 types of space buildings.

Asteroid belts can increase the dodge rate. But unlike that in Chaos Galaxy, ships can also enter asteroid belts. But light ARMS can move at full speed, and the movement of ships and heavy ARMS in asteroid belts is halved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/899a9f8783e53d36bad0127ce31741002c19cd92.png[/img]

Space buildings include factories, depots and institutes. Factories can restore the HP of units, depots can restore the EN of units, and institutes can restore the SP of characters. When the units on the building are attacked, the building will also lose durability. When the durability is reduced to 0, the building will become a ruin and lose the original recovery effect, but it can provide the same effect of increasing the dodge rate as the asteroid belt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/c1269181dd86271d3048eace6be06d8e75c13bb1.png[/img]

In addition, I also envision the possibility of adding stellar storms and black holes, but I am still thinking about their visual and effect performance.

One more thing, the Switch version of Chaos Galaxy 2 will be released in the Nintendo Store on May 8th. Friends who are interested in it can pay attention!

Well, I have to continue to draw the art resources. See you in the devlog next month.


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: Next Fest Report, DEMO 0.2, English Polishing
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been a week since the Next Fest. After the busy work at this stage, I finally have time to report to you.

From the release of the DEMO to the end of the Next Fest, the DEMO has been downloaded more than 7,000 times, and the number of wishlists has increased by 5,000. Compared with the performance of Chaos Galaxy 2 during the Next Fest in 2022, Chaos Front has doubled in popularity. Thank you for the support of old friends of the Chaos Galaxy series and new friends who like Chaos Front!

In the past half-month, I have received a lot of player feedback. Almost all the BUG reports received have been fixed. A lot of functional optimizations have been added based on DEMO 0.1. Here, I will select some important changes to report to you.

1. We have modified the save mechanism. Even if the game ends abnormally when saving, the existing save will not be lost.
2. Speed up the display speed of the interface and dialogue.
3. When playing the prologue, you can hold down the left mouse to pause the game to read the text.
4. During the battle animation, you can hold down the left or right mouse to play the animation at 2x speed.
5. In the battle confirmation interface, the hit rate to the target is displayed.
6. In the battle confirmation interface, if the player characters can use skills, a prompt grid will flash on the panel.
7. Added the mouse hover prompts for characters. You can see the data of characters in the interface for Selecting Protagonist Company and the interface for Mission rewards.
8. When you hover the mouse over the battlefield tiles, information such as the fog level, reefs, which captain the units are under command of, and the moving range of units will be displayed.

In addition, players who use English should find that the quality of English text in the game has improved dramatically in the past week. This is all the meticulous work of volunteer X-Calibre. He and I have repeatedly discussed every concept, name, and character in the game setting to find a description that is more suitable for Western culture. Let us express our sincere gratitude to him.

Based on DEMO 0.2, I will continue to develop the main content of Chaos Front. Since each of the four protagonists has a completely independent story process, I think the overall development time will be long. I hope to start the EA of the game in the third quarter of this year (the earliest time is at the end of July). At the beginning of EA, there will only be two protagonists to choose from. EA is expected to last about half a year, and the third and fourth protagonists, as well as other possible new features, will be completed before the official version.

Finally, thank you again for your support. My friends. Meet you in the devlog next month.

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: December Devlog: Faction Strategy
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This is the last devlog of the year, so let me introduce you to the faction strategy in Chaos Front.

In the Centersea War, four major factions are engaged in grand strategic actions. In the Faction Data Menu, we can see the Faction leaders and various intelligence data for all four factions. We can also see how friendly the mercenary corps we play is with this faction and the accumulated medals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/dda206a8f819f8cd3a6c4edff91f24e269c1ef38.png[/img]

According to the Astronautical Committee's new calendar, each year is divided into 12 months, and each month is divided into 30 days. 

When it comes to the 1st day of the month, all factions execute strategic actions for the month, such as investing in the industry in occupied areas, requesting support from their home countries, sending spies against enemy-occupied areas, launching wars, etc. 

Players are notified of all major actions in the form of broadcasts. And we can also see the planets at war on the big map and decide whether to go to join the war or not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/87c41b323fb9423eb5eb6d209a7cb0c596313d3a.png[/img]

There are four levels of relationship with a power: Hostile, Neutral, Trusted, and Ally. 

When you are hostile, you cannot enter the planetary orbit of the faction. 

When you are neutral, you can participate in less important operations of them. 

When you are trusted, you can participate in important operations of them, and you can also spend medals to receive ships and weapons exclusive to the faction. 

When we become an ally of a faction, we can even spend medals to initiate a strategic proposal to make that faction implement your proposal in the next month, and ultimately play with the direction of the entire Centersea War.

That's all for today. Let's meet again next year. Happy New Year to you!



Han Zhiyu

notes.title: November Devlog: Fight Animation
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Good news, I finally finished the fight animation feature this month! Let's take a look at two GIFs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/30614082923ca0e1b0a60c8e5f22284746dfecd7.gif[/img]

First, a mecha squad of the Lycurgus Corps attacks a pirate frigate. You can see that Lycurgus's attack adds a buff 'On Fire' to the enemy frigate. When the enemy ship fires back with machine guns, Lycurgus blows away the bullets with his spear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/395869ec205699fdb25deca2e26b9454cc5bd38c.gif[/img]

Next, Helen uses an Impactor to ram the enemy. Before the two pirate mechas can do anything, they are knocked away by the huge warship. On the battlefield map, we can see that the enemy unit hits an enemy ship behind, causing a second collision damage.

The quality of these two gifs is relatively low. As for the actual picture quality of the game, please wait for the video and DEMO later. Of course, more than 90% of the unit art and weapon effects are not completed, and a lot of work is still waiting for me to do.

That's all for today. See you next month!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: October Devlog
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This month, I have been working on the full-screen battle animation function. The related code has been almost completed, and next month I will produce the first batch of related art resources. This will be a long task.

In this blog, let me introduce the new feature I just added this month: the Catch system.

In Chaos Front, our mercenary corps can catch enemy arms in battle. Except for ships and ACE pilots' customized arms, most enemy arms can be caught and added to our arsenal. They can be sold or let our pilots drive them to fight. This system will bring some trouble to the economic system, but I know many players will like it! The difficulties of balance design can  be solved later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/cba9729b4cda7fcb73a9428ef8ea97d71d1992ec.png[/img]
As shown in the picture above, when our ships are close to enemy groups, we can select the command Catch from the command list.

Here we need to introduce the concept of Chaos first. When a pilot's morale is 0, they will continue to be in chaos. The ambush of the submarines will make the enemy fall into chaos immediately, and many character skills can also cause the enemy to be in chaos. Units in chaos will have a white flag sign on the upper right of the chess piece, and they cannot perform any actions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/0a33039d981843e1fb8f3a0132b6b00feb3de5fd.png[/img]
When the pilot of enemy arms is in chaos, our ships have a certain probability of catching it. The lower the morale, the higher the catching rate. If our captain has the talent of Pirate Captain, or our mercenary corps has the tradition of Space Pirates, the catching rate can be further improved.

It should be noted that ships cannot be caught, and although the enemy's ACE's customized arms can be caught, the arms will explode at the same time as being caught and cannot be obtained. In addition, once the catching fails, the enemy unit will wake up from the chaotic state and restore some morale.

That's all for today. Thank you for your patience and see you next month!



Han Zhiyu

notes.title: September Devlog
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This month, I have completed most of the battle-related codes, but the most important full-screen battle animation part has not yet started. Since we want to do it, we have to do it well. I will spend more time studying the details in the next month.

Now, let me introduce the arms customizing in Chaos Front.

In this game, our mercenary corps can buy many kinds of arms from Arms dealers and equip them with pilots. The attributes, talents, and skills of the pilots will bring many bonuses to the arms. In addition, we can spend credit points to customize these arms for a pilot in the factory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/2352b863bb72dae574b5573e89050bf864100562.png[/img]

As shown in the picture above, we can customize the Longbow for the three pilots Lycurgus, Pyrrhus, and Rossy. Each pilot has their own tendency, so the attributes added after customizing Longbow are also different.

When the customizing is completed, the name of this Longbow will become Longbow (Rossy), with an increase of 375 EN and 6 Agility. But these additional attributes will only take effect when Rossy drives it. When others drive it, the customized attributes will turn gray. Also, note that the customized attributes are not fixed. The higher the original attribute of the arms, the higher the transformation bonus attribute will be.

Combining different arms and different pilots, we can combine different customized units in a targeted manner to further exert the power of our mercenary corps.

That's all for today. I will continue to develop the battle animation function. See you next month!



Han Zhiyu

notes.title: August Devlog & DEMO Delay Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This month, I've finished most of the development of the big map gamesystem and found a way of using many forms to make complex mission levels. But as development progresses, I realize that I might be able to finish a usable DEMO in October, but it would be far from polished. Releasing it would probably disappoint everyone.

As a result, I had to regretfully pass on participating in the Steam Next Fest in October. The release of Chaos Front DEMO will be delayed until the next Steam Next Fest, which will be in February 2025. This October, I will release the first trailer for Chaos Front instead.

I deeply apologize for the delay of the DEMO. And, the release of the official version of Chaos Front will not change, it will still be in the spring of 2025, maybe around two months after the release of the DEMO.

Now, let's move on to the other two factions we didn't finish introducing last month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/84e93a1db11b1254da76ad2a6549edfd4bb4a685.png[/img]
Massilia was the first planet in the Centersea Sector to be colonized by humans, and as such became the shipping center of the entire Sector. At the time of the establishment of the Astronautical Committee, the then president of the local government of Massilia sold out the interests of the people and established the Principality of Massilia with the support of Three Super Powers, proclaiming himself the Duke of the Massilia, anointing the military officers and politicians who supported him as nobles, and suppressing Massilia as the Committee's henchmen.

With the monopoly of the Committee, Massilia lost its former status as a shipping center and its people fell into poverty. Anger accumulated for over twenty years, and a storm of revolution finally overthrew the Principality's government, and the staff, students, soldiers, and workers ...... of the newly formed Revolutionary Council became the masters of Massilia.

The first citizen of the revolutionary government was Charlotte, the Speaker of the Republic. She had worked as a lawyer for five years helping the poor people in their lawsuits and gradually realized that the greatest source of the people's suffering was precisely the exploitation of the Astronautical Committee and that only the overthrow of the Committee's tyranny throughout the galaxy could bring true happiness. With her determined lobbying and organizing, many important political and military figures joined the revolution. After the founding of the Republic, Charlotte was elected Speaker of the Republic. In the minds of the people, she seemed to be the embodiment of uncorrupted revolutionary ideals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/455787cf900fb335bb73385d81a03953d8730316.png[/img]
The Black Flag, an ally of the Revolutionary Army, was originally the Fleet Tertius of the Committee Army from the Qilin Dynasty. During the Great Rebellion that destroyed the Old Union, the Qilin Dynasty, which once had hopes of unifying the galaxy, fell into schism when the Emperor was poisoned and died. The Eight Wardens, who commanded the Eight Legions as the Emperor's arms, fought each other and lost half of their power in political struggles, plots assassinations, and bloody wars. In the end, the House Yuan became the highest-ranking Grand Warden, married the daughter to the new emperor, and became the behind-the-scenes ruler. The Qilin Dynasty, which had suffered a great deal of damage, also lost its ambition and accepted the proposal made by the other Super Powers to co-manage the Galaxy in the form of the Committee.

The House Li, one of the Eight Wardens, survived the hegemonic government politics of the Grand Warden due to humility and luck and got through a succession for the House head. However, the powerful House Li was always suspected by the House Yuan. With the outbreak of the Centersea War, the three Super Powers were obliged to send their fleets to suppress Massilia. Grand Warden Yuan Wen came up with the idea of killing two birds with one stone by ordering Li Cunyi, the head of the House Li, to lead the Li's subordinates in an expedition to Centersea Sector as the Commander-in-Chief of the Fleet Tertius. This not only banished Li Cunyi from the power center of the dynasty but also depleted the reputation and strength of the House Li in a war without righteousness.

However, after the House Li fleet arrived at the Bazhou Planet in the Centersea Sector, Li Cunyi suddenly ordered the entire army to remove the flag of the Qilin Dynasty, paint their ships and arms black, expel all the committee bodies in the neighboring planets, and send out alliance emissaries to the Revolutionary Army. The Black Flag was born. Li Cunyi, who has been humbling in silence for a mission no one knows, finally rises as a dragon emerges from the abyss and is about to start the legend of the Black Admiral.

That's all for today, let's look forward to next month's trailer!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: July DevLog: Committee Army
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The Demo of Chaos Front is in the final two months of development. In this dev log, let me talk about the lore of the Committee Army.

The picture below is a map of the Centersea War, which has been deadlocked in AC 25. The red planets are controlled by the Massilian Revolutionary Army, the black planets are controlled by the Black Flag, the purple planets are controlled by the Fleet Primus of Committee Army, the blue planets are controlled by the Fleet Secundus of Committee Army, and the green planet is the neutral city planet Kowloon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/082a50963deae63eef188d5ceb39192e0aadbff2.png[/img]
As a tool for the three Superpowers to rule the galaxy, the Astronautical Committee controls the interstellar shipping of the entire galaxy. Each planetary government and enterprise must pay a huge shipping management fee regularly to obtain authorization to send ships for inter-system navigation. Unauthorized spaceships, including the vessel and cargo, will be confiscated by the Committee's gendarmerie and will be directly shot down if they resist. Through this means, in just 25 years, the Astronautical Committee has accumulated huge wealth, and the three Superpowers have also obtained huge economic benefits through privileges.

Faced with the revolution launched by Massilia, the Astronautical Committee decided that the three Superpowers would send fleets, allocate military funds from the Committee's treasury, and form a joint army to conquer Massilia. However, the Fleet Tertius from the Qilin Dynasty suddenly announced its separation from the Committee Army in Bazhou and became independent from the Qilin Dynasty, called itself the Black Flag, and formed an alliance with the Massilian Revolutionary Army. Therefore, the Committee Army in the Centersea War only included the Fleet Primus from the Republic of Legions and the Fleet Secundus from the Shining Federation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/b8cbf7f24f3a5fe9d2ca06e79ae10ae68abc267f.png[/img]
The Commander-in-Chief of the Fleet Primus was Marshal Crassus, one of the Five Marshals of the Republic of Legions. He was one of the most powerful warlords in RoL. Once he could lead the army to quell the Massilian Revolution, he would have a great chance of seizing the throne of the Imperator of RoL. But unexpectedly, under the resistance of the Revolutionary Army and the Black Flag, the Centersea War fell into a stalemate. Crassus was full of anger at the traitors and struggled hard in the political quagmire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/32d2562e61de687ef29be8cbc40d2b5f6bd6cfdd.png[/img]
The Commander-in-Chief of the Fleet Secundus was General Dwight of the Shining Federation. Rather than saying that he was a military strategist who was good at leading troops in battle, it was better to say that he was a politician who was good at coordination and personnel management. Within the SF, there was also a political trend against sacrificing soldiers for the Committee and demanding that the Shining Federation's own interests take precedence. Therefore, in the Centersea War, the Fleet Secundus was not as active as the Fleet Primus.

In Chaos Front, our mercenary corps can not only participate in the battle to assist the Committee Army but also learn about the people and secrets within these organizations through various missions and get involved in related major events.

That's all for this devlog. Let's talk more next month!


Han Zhiyu

notes.title: June DevLog: Combat Mode
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this devlog, let me introduce the concept of "Combat mode" in Chaos Front.

On the battlefield, the enemy and our army fight as a chess game with multiple units. Each unit may be a single ship, a single large arms, or a squad of up to three small arms.

The arms in each squad are numbered 1, 2, or 3, and in close combat, both sides fight individually with #1 against #1, #2 against #2, and #3 against #3. If #2 or #3 has no opponent with the same number, they will attack the opposite #1.

As shown in the picture below, the three mecha of the Revolutionary Army launched close combat against the three mecha of our Lycurgus Corps. Revolutionary Army squad's arms #1, #2, and #3 shoot to attack our #1, #2, and #3 respectively. Our #1 melee back against enemy #1, our #2 shoot back against enemy #2, and our #3 is dodging. In addition, our #1 uses the skill Heavy Blow to increase damage and our #2 uses the skill Effort to gain more exp.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/cdea16486057907bd46cb4c58c3834cce30cc344.png[/img]

All our units can choose available actions and skills during combat.

Below is a Revolutionary Army ship range attack our squad, and unlike close combat, it is impossible to return fire against enemy range attack. However, it is still possible to use power shields or dodge it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/29dc9a32e502d986e2e2493a4e4b6339aef4ffe9.png[/img]

The picture below shows our impactor ramming an enemy mecha squad. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/3d8f6f529b09c1eb292265260176111cbd31c093.png[/img]

Notice that a red indicator appears underneath the enemy ship in front of the enemy mecha squad being rammed. When the enemy mecha Squad is knocked back, it will collide with the enemy ship, dealing additional damage to them. This is the special ability of the ram weapons. Assuming that the ramming takes place at the edge of the map, it can drive the enemy right off the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/5968dcfd7c195d68f37f78f8e2224de0fc079a7d.png[/img]

In addition to the close combat, range bombard, and ramming mentioned above, there are several other combat modes, including space mines and psychic weapons. Let's experience and study them in the future game.

That's all for this devlog. Let's talk more next month!



Han Zhiyu

notes.title: May DevLog: Formation
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Over the past two months, I have finished designing most of the Chaos Front UI. Now, it's time to start coding. I'm aiming to release the game demo in October, which is four months away!

In this devlog, I want to introduce the concept of 'Formation' in Chaos Front.

Units in the game are divided into two main categories: Ships and Arms. Arms are further divided into two types: small and large. S-type units like Mecha and fighters can be stacked in squads of up to three, while L-type units like Artillery and Titans cannot be stacked with other arms. Since arms can't travel long distances in space on their own, they need to be carried on a ship to reach the mission target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/5c0b105c144758b11e57f3f5b71025d10c688db0.png[/img]

Our mercenary corps can deploy a maximum of four ships in the strike force. Each ship has a specific number of small and large hangars. Small arms can be placed in both types of hangars, but large arms can only be placed in large hangars. For example, the Impactor has three small hangars and one large hangar, while the Freighter only has three small hangars. It's important to note that all units in the strike force must have a captain or pilot.

Different missions have a limit of 1-4 ships. Even for missions with a limit of one ship, you can send 4 ships full of arms to strike. However, this will cost you extra maintenance and may even offset the mission rewards gained.

On the battlefield, ships can provide ability bonuses to arms within a certain command range. When the arms are low on HP and EN (Energy), they can return to the ship to recover. However, it's important to note that all HP and EN recovered are deducted from that ship's EN. When a ship is destroyed, all arms inside are also destroyed.

Additionally, ships can carry up to 4 items while weapons can carry up to 2 items. These items can provide restoration and ability enhancements. For example, the Repairer can restore HP, and the Thruster can dramatically increase the unit's movement in a turn.

The game's settings are still being refined and adjusted. Even after the demo is completed, further adjustments will be made based on your suggestions. That's all for this devlog. Let's talk more next month!

Han Zhiyu

notes.title: April DevLog: Characters
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's time for the monthly DevLog again.

In Chaos Front, there are two types of characters: 'Captain' and 'Pilot'. They have different abilities and attributes, and can respectively drive ships and arms. To help you understand their differences better, let's take a look at two examples.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/2a83871c77e2d805b58a1e5836b1e0edf6d7a3f5.gif[/img]

Captain Helen, for instance, has four attributes: Shoot, Maneuver, Command, and Skill Point. When she controls a ship, her 'Shoot' attribute increases the hit rate of the ship's shooting weapons. 'Maneuver', on the other hand, helps the ship avoid enemy fire and increases the damage of the ram weapon if equipped. 'Command' can increase the damage of friendly arms or reduce the damage they take within her command range. Higher SP means Helen can use more and stronger skills during the battle. Every time she levels up, these attributes will increase.

The blue entries below 'Merchant Lv1' and 'Commander Lv1' represent Helen's talents when she reaches Captain Level 2. They respectively allow her to obtain more mission rewards and increase her command range. With every level, Helen will either gain a new talent or add one level to an existing talent. The maximum talent level is 5.

'Reinforce' is Helen's Skill which can be used on the battlefield by consuming SP to recover the HP of friendly units. Each role has three skills, and the remaining two are unlocked as the role levels up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/68b0bf99ed6f704a3798eba2e97b81d2226aaa28.gif[/img]

Now let's talk about Pilot Pyrrhus. He cannot command a spaceship, but he can fight in a mecha or other arms. Pyrrhus also has four attributes: Shoot, Melee, Reaction, and SP. The 'Shoot' and 'SP' attributes are the same as Helen's. The 'Melee' attribute increases the damage of Melee weapons, while 'Reaction' increases the dodge rate and parry rate of his unit.

His talents, 'Shielder Lv1', increase the shield's durability, and 'Fencer Lv1' makes it easier to trigger a Preemptive strike when using Melee weapons. After using the skill "Effort", he can increase the EXP gained in battle.

By the way, some players have asked how many characters there are in Chaos Front. We can confirm that there are over 120 characters in total, but the characters that each Corps can collect are only a portion of them.

That's all for today. I will be back next month.

Best regards,



Han Zhiyu

notes.title: March DevLog: Big Map
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

In this month's development log, I'd like to show you the big map of Chaos Front. The map includes seventeen planetary worlds and many important places within the Centersea Sector. Your mercenary corps can move around the map on your flagship, and time advances as you move on. However, time won't pass if you stay in one place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/99c90b3bfea30fa0cdfcb52fe860dea9e5cb59f6.gif[/img]
When you reach a planetary world, you can take missions, and buy ships and arms, and some planets have gladiatorial arenas and army HQs. When you take a mission, an exclamation point animation will appear at the place where the mission is triggered. Moving the mouse over the place will show you how many days it will take to move to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899838/c8e39ce4a42b7df620fd36273b77d6e97e5c45fa.gif[/img]
Periodically, the warring armies will launch battles for the planets. You can see the intense animation of the two fleets on the map. Move your mercenary corps to the warring planets,  you can choose which side to join and participate in the battle.

That's all for today. I will be back next month.

Best regards,



Han Zhiyu

notes.title: CHAOS FRONT Announced!
notes.notes:
Hello, my friends!

After a year of preparation (which has been delayed for too long), I can finally share with you the information about my new work CHAOS FRONT.

Perhaps some players know that in the initial planning, I had planned to place the game stage on a planet and its orbit, let mecha engage in battles on the land, ocean, ice field, desert, and space, create cut-screen combat animations, and replace mecha components. However, after several months of trying, I found it difficult for me to solve the problem of artistic expression. When a mecha needs to fly in the air, walk on the ground, and swim in the sea, with one side on the ground and the other in the sky or ocean, there should be differences in the shooting and moving show of both sides. This means that a massive amount of artwork is needed to ensure visual correction.

As an indie developer, my ability lies in creating interesting gameplay, rather than making tons of art as a big company. I can only painfully abandon this plan.

The new design direction of CHAOS FRONT is more interesting than the initial plan. We are no longer playing the role of a faction like in Chaos Galaxy. Instead, we play a mercenary corps in a war-torn galaxy, set in the dark era after the downfall of the Solar Union 1000 years ago before Chaos Galaxy. 

In this game, our mercenary corps can travel on spaceships in a space sector that has nearly twenty planets, recruiting various characters, including captains, pilots, and even psychics. We can purchase ships, mecha, artillery, fighters, and even titans. Although it is not possible to freely change weapons for units as originally envisioned, most units can be made a modification that includes changes in their appearance and abilities.

We can complete mercenary missions to earn gold and reputation and join a faction to take part in battles. With the strengthening of your mercenary corps and changes in the battlefront, there will ultimately be multiple different game endings.

Most importantly, the new game will feature meticulously crafted cutscreen combat animations!

Now let's talk about the development schedule. I hope to take October 2024 as a milestone, when we will be able to see game videos and play the game demo. The release date is in the spring of 2025, and I will try my best to complete it as early as possible.

Hope you can add this game to your wishlist, and I will publish development logs every month. Let's keep in touch!


Han Zhiyu
